full_name: Kimberly McClain DaCosta | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2004–2005 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Harvard University
bio: Kimberly McClain DaCosta, an assistant professor of African and African American studies and of social studies at Harvard University, is interested in the intersection of cultural ideas about race and family.
